objects.name: fki_collectionItems_itemID_parentItemID
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fki_collectionItems_itemID_parentItemID  BEFORE INSERT ON collectionItems  FOR EACH ROW BEGIN    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'insert on table "collectionItems" violates foreign key constraint "fki_collectionItems_itemID_parentItemID"')    WHERE NEW.itemID IN (SELECT itemID FROM itemAttachments WHERE parentItemID IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT itemID FROM itemNotes WHERE parentItemID IS NOT NULL);  END

objects.name: fki_collectionItems_libraryID
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fki_collectionItems_libraryID  BEFORE INSERT ON collectionItems  FOR EACH ROW BEGIN    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'insert on table "collectionItems" violates foreign key constraint "fki_collectionItems_libraryID"')    WHERE (SELECT libraryID FROM collections WHERE collectionID = NEW.collectionID) != (SELECT libraryID FROM items WHERE itemID = NEW.itemID);  END

objects.name: fki_collections_parentCollectionID_libraryID
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fki_collections_parentCollectionID_libraryID  BEFORE INSERT ON collections  FOR EACH ROW BEGIN    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'insert on table "collections" violates foreign key constraint "fki_collections_parentCollectionID_libraryID"')    WHERE NEW.parentCollectionID IS NOT NULL AND    NEW.libraryID != (SELECT libraryID FROM collections WHERE collectionID = NEW.parentCollectionID);  END

objects.name: fki_tagsBEFORE
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fki_tagsBEFORE INSERT ON tags  FOR EACH ROW BEGIN    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Tag cannot be blank')    WHERE TRIM(NEW.name)='';  END

objects.name: fku_collectionItems_itemID_parentItemID
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fku_collectionItems_itemID_parentItemID  BEFORE UPDATE OF itemID ON collectionItems  FOR EACH ROW BEGIN    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'update on table "collectionItems" violates foreign key constraint "fku_collectionItems_itemID_parentItemID"')    WHERE NEW.itemID IN (SELECT itemID FROM itemAttachments WHERE parentItemID IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT itemID FROM itemNotes WHERE parentItemID IS NOT NULL);  END

objects.name: fku_collectionItems_libraryID
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fku_collectionItems_libraryID  BEFORE UPDATE ON collectionItems  FOR EACH ROW BEGIN    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'update on table "collectionItems" violates foreign key constraint "fku_collectionItems_libraryID"')    WHERE (SELECT libraryID FROM collections WHERE collectionID = NEW.collectionID) != (SELECT libraryID FROM items WHERE itemID = NEW.itemID);  END

objects.name: fku_collections_parentCollectionID_libraryID
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fku_collections_parentCollectionID_libraryID  BEFORE UPDATE ON collections  FOR EACH ROW BEGIN    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'update on table "collections" violates foreign key constraint "fku_collections_parentCollectionID_libraryID"')    WHERE NEW.parentCollectionID IS NOT NULL AND    NEW.libraryID != (SELECT libraryID FROM collections WHERE collectionID = NEW.parentCollectionID);  END

objects.name: fku_itemAttachments_parentItemID_collectionItems_itemID
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fku_itemAttachments_parentItemID_collectionItems_itemID  BEFORE UPDATE OF parentItemID ON itemAttachments  FOR EACH ROW WHEN OLD.parentItemID IS NULL AND NEW.parentItemID IS NOT NULL BEGIN    DELETE FROM collectionItems WHERE itemID = NEW.itemID;  END
